scope: Audit and correction of buried-substrate roughness, coastal shading derivatives and native grazing material energy. Presentation only: no authoritative heights, topology, simulation, contacts, water classification or vegetation geometry change.

reproduced_failures.before: At 250 K under opaque snow, basalt/felsic roughness differed: 0.76019907 vs 0.76219904.
reproduced_failures.fix: Weight the bounded geology roughness prior by uncovered substrate, using the existing vegetation, snow and frost opacity weights.

reproduced_failures.before: The water-side derivative sample was 0 instead of the continuous grain value 0.7648140995514645.
reproduced_failures.fix: Evaluate the land grain's cardinal derivative halo even across the water mask; keep ocean output normals flat and all-ocean pages grain-free.

reproduced_failures.before: Regular roughness_u8=153, N.V=0.05: [255,255,255] vs independent solid-angle reference [140,140,140]. The old sky floor passed the previous lower-bound test despite this BRDF error.
reproduced_failures.fix: Cancel N.V analytically in Gv_Schlick/Gv_GGX before evaluating its finite limit, and remove the artificial sky floor. Rejected below-surface samples remain in the denominator.

reproduced_failures.before: After removing the floor, regular Low white substrate at N.V=0.2 returned [34,34,34] instead of the white-furnace [51,51,51]. Macro-normal Schlick removed too much diffuse for the rough reflected lobe.
reproduced_failures.fix: Use reciprocal first-substrate-bounce diffuse albedo*(1-R(view))*(1-R(light))/pi, with R from the same GGX law. Aggregate ambient uses a four-direction cosine-weighted average incoming R (isotropic approximation). Extra material quadrature is measured; no new field/pass or full rough-interface refraction/multiple-scattering solver.

independent_code_review.rejected_intermediate: An outgoing-only complement passed its white furnace but was nonreciprocal and produced approximately 2.5% excess energy for a grazing collimated source at roughness 1. A second issue let cloud transport sample count change material/direct response. Both were corrected before commit.
independent_code_review.final_result: No blocking implementation issues found in the revised two-sided closure; legacy Bevy macro-Schlick behavior preserved. Review was source and CPU arithmetic, not independent GPU execution.
independent_code_review.test_feedback: Raised furnace radiance and direct-source illuminance after review showed incoming-factor omissions could hide below RGB8 tolerance. Final raster tolerance is 1 level at High, 2 at cheaper tiers. Energy compute probe reconstructs the product from actual shader material functions; raster direct/furnace fixtures separately check production wiring.

shared_wgsl_compute_probe.fixture: Uniform radiance 100, roughness 0.5, 16-direction production visible-normal quadrature; independent solid-angle BRDF midpoint integration.

numerical_envelopes.grazing_raster: Independent solid-angle reference at N.V=0.7/0.2/0.05/0.01, roughness_u8=153/255, regular/conforming, High, tolerance 8 RGB8 levels.
numerical_envelopes.white_grey_furnace: Uniform radiance 8 and diffuse illuminance 8*pi, substrate sRGB 255/128, roughness 1, N.V=0.7/0.2/0.05/0.01, all quality tiers and both topologies; expected omitted-bounce deficit, tolerance 1 RGB8 level at High and 2 at cheaper tiers, no output above incoming furnace radiance.
numerical_envelopes.no_field_direct: White substrate, roughness 1, normal source illuminance 9*pi, N.V=1/0.05, all tiers and both topologies. Independent direct/specular reference and exact unchanged output when publishing zero-extinction clouds without a sky field.
numerical_envelopes.directional_energy: Actual WGSL material functions plus direct specular, independent 128x256 outgoing solid-angle integration, roughness 0.45/0.6/1, incident cosine 0.01/0.2/1, 4/8/16 samples: outgoing fractions 0.957818..0.985663, envelope <=1.005. Specular reciprocity max 0.000069759 (bound 0.0001); diffuse product symmetric by construction. Average material reflectance vs independent BRDF integration has absolute tolerance 0.01.
numerical_envelopes.boundary: Fixture-specific absolute bounds, not certified finite-quadrature passivity for all directions/materials, a convergence proof for the energy grid, or arbitrary HDR sky/bump-map/layered-material guarantees. Aggregate ambient loses angular information; missing internal substrate return bounces cause a deliberate energy deficit.
